Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting various recruitment examinations in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India.

UPSSSC aims to provide employment opportunities to eligible candidates in various government departments and organizations.

The UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Main Examination 2026 is a recruitment examination conducted by UPSSSC to fill 1308 vacancies for the post of Veterinary Pharmacist.

The examination aims to select eligible candidates for the post of Veterinary Pharmacist in various government departments and organizations in Uttar Pradesh, India.
